channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: SDF does not represent Syrian Kurds, says Fidan
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said on Jan. 23 that the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) do not represent Syrian Kurds, describing the group as an extension of the outlawed PKK and urging the removal of non-Syrian PKK members from Syria.

item.title: Havuş Deli: Shop reminding Istanbul of what it forgot
item.description: Ömür Akkor’s Havuş Deli project redefines the concept of fast food through Anatolian techniques: Real ingredients, accessible pricing and a producer-centered table culture

item.title: Antalya steps up push to become gastronomy destination
item.description: The Mediterranean province of Antalya, known internationally as one of Türkiye’s leading tourism hubs, is now making a concerted move to establish itself as a destination for gastronomy tourism by cataloguing, protecting and promoting its local food heritage.

item.title: Spanish tourist arrivals to Türkiye quadruple over past decade
item.description: Over the last decade, the number of Spanish tourists visiting Türkiye has increased fourfold to approximately 420,000 as of late 2025, a growth mirrored by a doubling of direct flights that underscores the strengthening tourism and cultural ties between the two nations, according to Turkish officials.

item.title: Türkiye overtakes Italy to become world’s second-biggest olive oil producer
item.description: Türkiye has overtaken Italy to become the world’s second-largest producer of olive oil after Spain, while also rising to the top spot in table olives, according to the International Olive Council (IOC).

item.title: Fitch revises Türkiye outlook to positive, affirms BB- rating
item.description: Fitch Ratings upgraded its outlook Friday on Türkiye’s long-term foreign-currency issuer default rating to positive from stable, while affirming the rating at “BB-.”

item.title: Turkish Basketball Federation urges EuroLeague action after insults aimed at coach in Tel Aviv
item.description: The Turkish Basketball Federation (TBF) on Jan. 24 condemned abusive chants directed at Ergin Ataman during a EuroLeague game in Tel Aviv and called on the league to launch disciplinary proceedings to prevent similar incidents.

item.title: Syria denies reports of extending SDF ceasefire as sources say truce may be prolonged
item.description: Syria’s Foreign Ministry denied reports that a four-day ceasefire with the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) has been extended, Syrian state television reported on Jan. 24.

item.title: Ukraine says deadly Russian strikes threaten US-backed peace talks
item.description: Negotiators from Russia, Ukraine and the United States will meet in Abu Dhabi on Saturday for the second day of negotiations on a plan being pushed by U.S. President Donald Trump to end the almost four-year-long war.

item.title: Erdoğan says West now echoes Türkiye’s criticism of global system
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on Jan. 24 that the global order built after World War II is “cracking at its foundations,” warning that “the law of the strong” is increasingly replacing the rule of law.
